name: vintage_eligibility_bundle_purchase_surplus_resale
question_template: A firm must retire exactly {E} carbon credits against this year's target. A credit is eligible for retirement only if its vintage year is {C} or later. The firm already holds {H} credits, all of vintage {V}. If the held credits are eligible, they are applied to the target first and any held credits beyond the target become surplus; if ineligible, none are applied and all {H} are sold at the legacy price of {L} USD per credit. Any remaining shortfall is covered by buying eligible credits only in whole bundles of {B} credits at {PRICE} USD per credit, using the fewest bundles that cover the shortfall. All surplus credits (bundle excess plus any excess eligible held credits) are resold at {D} percent below the purchase price. Compute the net cash outlay in USD as purchase cost minus all resale and legacy proceeds.

slots.description: Held credits counted toward the target after the vintage eligibility test.
Fewest whole bundles needed to cover the remaining shortfall.
Total surplus credits resold, from bundle excess and excess eligible holdings.

program:
def solve():
    E = P["E"]
    H = P["H"]
    V = P["V"]
    C = P["C"]
    B = P["B"]
    price = P["PRICE"]
    D = P["D"]
    L = P["L"]
    if V >= C:
        applied = min(H, E)
        held_surplus = H - applied
        legacy_proceeds = 0
    else:
        applied = 0
        held_surplus = 0
        legacy_proceeds = H * L
    shortfall = E - applied
    bundles = (shortfall + B - 1) // B
    purchased = bundles * B
    surplus = (purchased - shortfall) + held_surplus
    resale_price = price * (1 - D / 100)
    net_outlay = purchased * price - surplus * resale_price - legacy_proceeds
    return {
        "final": net_outlay,
        "applied_held_credits": applied,
        "bundles_purchased": bundles,
        "surplus_credits": surplus,
    }
